testcase.name: tool references allow exact directory hosts and reject arbitrary URLs, ports and credentials
query construction encodes literal text and uses only observed public parameters
public render data preserves genuine zero, false, Unicode and category names
unrelated recommendations and ads are excluded from the result list
a valid empty page differs from a broken layout or blocked response
ignored filters are detected instead of mislabeled as applied
page scripts are parsed only as JSON and are never executed
detail metadata preserves reported API/no-open-source and not-returned dates
detail identity changes and missing application metadata fail explicitly
identical concurrent reads coalesce; cache preserves original fetch timestamp
requests use no credentials and do not fetch vendor, tracking or private API URLs
HTTP 401 is an explicit error, never an empty catalog or a retry flood
HTTP 403 is an explicit error, never an empty catalog or a retry flood
HTTP 404 is an explicit error, never an empty catalog or a retry flood
HTTP 500 is an explicit error, never an empty catalog or a retry flood
429 cooldown prevents a second upstream request and exposes retry delay
cross-origin redirect is rejected before another fetch; same-origin tool redirects are bounded
unexpected MIME, invalid UTF-8 and oversized bodies are not silently parsed
network failures are sanitized and do not leak upstream exception text
timeout covers response body consumption
real XLSX round-trips Unicode, literal formula-like text, numeric zero and coverage
CSV protects whitespace-prefixed formulas and preserves quotes and newlines
CSV and JSON exports retain source URLs and timestamps
local artifacts are real files in the configured directory; resource expiry is explicit
official SDK client invokes all 15 tools through Streamable HTTP
download and resources/read return identical XLSX bytes under the same bearer/Origin rules
invalid exports and unknown or excessive arguments are rejected
access errors retain data_absence_confirmed=false through MCP
legacy stdio framing supports initialize, 15 tools, and real tool calls
real Node HTTP server enforces Host, bearer, Origin and body size
search passes category, pricing, sort and page to the actual directory URL
taxonomy uses the source category labels, not derived guesses
server clamping to page one is detected
batch deduplicates references and retains partial 404 failures
blocked batch stops new reads and marks later records unattempted
comparison requires distinct tools and preserves source facts, not a fabricated ranking
alternatives resolve the exact seed card category and exclude the seed
alternatives do not guess a category when the exact seed is absent from search
bounded collection paginates without claiming the full query
two-page collection retrieves all unique records and verifies complete query coverage
later-page failure preserves earlier records and discloses incomplete selection
selected-reference exports have distinct selection coverage and preserve real details
